about_the_game:
Feed the School! is a fast-paced cooking sim with a fiery twist!

As the newly hired school chef, your job is to serve up tasty meals to hungry students, manage orders, and upgrade your kitchen to survive the growing lunchtime frenzy.

But there’s a twist: spice things up by secretly slipping flaming hot chili peppers into the evil teachers’ meals!
Take down the staff one spicy blast at a time and earn your title as a true lunchtime legend!

Features

  • Chaotic Cooking Fun
    Juggle cooking, plating, and serving in a fast-paced school kitchen that’ll keep your adrenaline sizzling.

  • Kitchen Glow-up
    Unlock cool gadgets and tasty upgrades to serve faster, sharper, and spicier than ever.

  • Turn up the heat
    Supercharge your chilies to bring the burn! These spice levels will push every teacher to their limit!

  • Epic Teacher Reactions
    Drop in those fiery chilies and brace yourself for hilarious, over-the-top teacher reactions!

  • Engaging Gameplay Loop
    Cook, serve, prank, upgrade - and repeat. Every lunchtime gets spicier, sillier and more satisfying.

What Makes 'Feed the School!' So Special?

  • Pranks on the Menu
    This isn’t your typical cooking game. It’s a wild mix of kitchen chaos and spicy mischief!

  • Big Characters, Even Bigger Reactions
    Every teacher comes with a wild personality - and even wilder meltdowns when the heat kicks in.

  • Bring the Whole School to Its Knees
    Take down teachers one spicy blast at a time - until no one’s left standing!

Fans of Bash the Teacher will recognise some familiar teachers and the same chaotic school setting - only this time, the madness moves to the cafeteria!

Class Dismissed!

Feed the School! is the most deliciously unhinged cooking game you’ll ever play. So fire up the grill, pile on the chilies, and join the lunchtime revolution!

  • Storage: 500 MB available space
